text:
Asha (engineering lead): quick follow-up from today's all-hands — thanks for the great Q&A. this thread is to capture the reliability RCA, the concrete follow-ups, and any clarifications leadership promised. RCA link (internal): https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-03-23/cache-index-rebuild. please reply with confirmations or blocks.

Raj (CTO): thanks Asha. short framing from leadership: we prioritise stability-first for serving infra; funding for the dedicated-runtime observability work is approved, expect hiring + infra budget next quarter. Lina / product teams, we'll surface a roadmap blip for Optimize to reflect this.

Lina (product): appreciate that context. can you confirm whether the observability investment shifts our Optimize Q3 items? PMs wanted to know if KV cache visibility becomes top-3.

Raj (CTO): yes — KV & route observability will be P1 for Optimize in Q3. we'll re-scope a couple of lower-impact experiments. I'll post a short note to the roadmap doc.

Ben (SRE): regarding the incident: RCAs notes show the cache-index rebuild caused 5xx spikes for ~12 minutes (04:18-04:30 UTC) on dedicated pools. mitigation was an emergency fallback to read-through mode. rollout of the index fix is staged; owner: Ben.

Tariq (eng-runtime): i'll add the trace-span for index_rebuild_id so we can correlate rebuild runs with tail latency. PR to instrumentation in review: https://redwood.internal/git/trace-rebuild-tag.

Maya (support): support needs the exact impact window and affected customers to prepare comms. can someone paste the impact blurb we should use?

Asha (engineering lead): paste from RCA "Impact: ~12m elevated error rate and tail latency impacting 6% of routed requests on dedicated routing between 04:18 and 04:30 UTC. Affected customers: orgs using pinned-index routing (export in RCA attachments)." will DM sensitive list to support.

Lina (product): product ask — can we get a 1-line Console timeline entry + a short FAQ line for support docs? Maya, want to co-author?

Maya (support): yes, happy to co-author. i'll wait for the org export then draft.

Ben (SRE): deployment plan for the index patch: canary 8% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m observation windows and automated rollback on sustained 5xx > 0.8%. i'll own the rollout and post runbook steps to eng-sre.

inc-bot: deploy started by Ben to canary pool gpux-dedicated-3 (canary=8%)  build 2026.03.23-index-fix.

Tariq (eng-runtime): new metrics proposal: inference.cache.index_rebuild_in_progress (gauge) and inference.cache.index_rebuild_error_rate (counter). suggest alert: error_rate > 0.5% over 10m. adding to RCA metrics section.

Raj (CTO): leadership request: please quantify expected customer cost of the longer rebuilds (storage egress / extra CPU). finance needs a rough number for the Q3 budget brief. Ben / Tariq, can you produce a short estimate?

Ben (SRE): will produce estimate — rough first pass by EOD tomorrow.

Tariq (eng-runtime): i'll help with the rebuild CPU/time metrics and a sample S3 ingress/egress calc. 2d ETA.

Lina (product): roadmap update: i've flagged a small Optimize ticket to add "index rebuild visibility" with an initial scope of dashboard + one alert. target milestone: Q3 sprint 1.

Maya (support): once we have the console blurb and org list i'll push the canned email and an in-console notification. ETA for draft: today EOD.

Asha (engineering lead): to keep this actionable i've added an action table in the RCA: Ben (rollout & runbook, ETA today), Tariq (metrics + PR, ETA 48h), Lina (Console timeline + roadmap update, ETA 24h), Maya (support comms + emails, ETA EOD). please confirm by reply.

Ben (SRE): confirmed. posting runbook snippet shortly.

Tariq (eng-runtime): confirmed. PR link in thread when merged.

Lina (product): confirmed. will drop the timeline copy below when ready.

Maya (support): confirmed. waiting for org export.

Raj (CTO): one ask from leadership: schedule a 30m blameless review — include incident timeline, RCA summary, and a short list of proposed actions. target next Tue. Ben please coordinate.

Ben (SRE): scheduling now. will include logs, timeline snapshot, and the runbook.

inc-bot: deploy to 25% started by Ben  build 2026.03.23-index-fix.

Asha (engineering lead): final note — if anyone hits a blocker on their owner items, flag in this thread and i'll help remove blockers. otherwise i'll mark actions as in-progress in the RCA later today. thanks all for the quick follow-up. :clap:
